note: Render equation: sigma=0.5(A dx²+C dy²)+B dx dy (delta=mean-pixel_center, center=+0.5), alpha=min(0.99, opac·exp(-sigma)), valid=!(sigma<0 || alpha<1/255), early termination at next_T=T(1-alpha)<=1e-4 **exclusive** (the triggering Gaussian is not included, Fwd.cu:246-251). last_ids = the **absolute isect index** (relative to flatten_ids) of the last contributing Gaussian, or 0 when nothing contributed (a dual-purpose encoding — because MAX_ALPHA=0.99 the first Gaussian can never cross the threshold, so there is no contamination, Fwd.cu:186/261/293). The background is applied globally in one pass outside the tile loop: render_colors += (1-render_alphas)·bg (07 Correction 4 — bg is written to the in-bounds pixels of empty tiles as well). masks=None is fixed (07 Correction 6). flatten_ids is the **sorted golden** (the isect sort contract, 03), and isect_offsets is the global [I,TH,TW] cumulative sum. Comparison: render_colors/render_alphas with tolerances, last_ids **exact** (the flake policy at the threshold boundary is 07 open question #5 — to be decided after measurement). The Metal bwd test feeds this fixture's fwd goldens (render_alphas/last_ids) in as input to block fwd error propagation (07). bwd: inject v_render_colors/v_render_alphas → v_means2d/v_conics/v_colors/v_opacities (last_ids is not differentiated). A Gaussian with the MAX_ALPHA clamp active contributes 0 to v_conics/v_means2d/v_opacities and only v_colors survives (the clamp_max autograd ≡ the Bwd.cu:259 gate). Self-verification: (a) T decays monotonically and the surviving T>1e-4, (b) the render_alphas==1-T_final identity (f64 1e-12), (c) an all-pixel comparison against a serial per-pixel scalar oracle (a literal translation of the CUDA fwd), (d) the raster_small hand-check assertions. The total fixtures size cap was relaxed to < 2MB by approval (the 1c Task 2 brief) — the raster image tensors [I,H,W,{3,1}] (render/v_render) dominate the size. The nobg and bg variants share the same input and grad seeds (byte-identical upstream) — v_colors is identical between the variants, and only v_means2d/v_conics/v_opacities diverge through the bg term (v_alpha).
